h: The Promise That Torah’s Bread and Wine Remain Israel’s

p: "Hashem has sworn by His right hand
and by the arm of His might:
I will no longer give your grain
and foreigners shall not drink your wine
עַל אֵיזֶה זְמַן נֶאֱמַר הַשְּׁבוּעָה זוֹ
to what time was this oath said?
Why, at the time of the Destruction
the enemies took the grain and the wine then,
and from the time of the Destruction until today
לֹא הָיָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד אֶרֶץ שֶׁלָּהֶם
Yisrael has had no land of their own.
"by His right hand and by the arm of His might";
"'By His right hand' — this is Torah," etc.;
"'and by the arm of His might' — these are tefillin";
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 269a)
it is stated: "and by the arm of His might,"
and "might" is none other than Torah;
and this is as is expounded (Zevachim 116a)
"Hashem will give might to His people,"
And why was there need for this
עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא עֵקֶב רעא, ב)
follows what it says (Ra'aya Mehemna, Eikev, 271b)
"this is the bread of the Written Torah,
and the wine of the Oral Torah."
אֵין מִקְרָא יוֹצֵא מִידֵי פְשׁוּטוֹ גַּם כֵּן
a verse does not depart from its plain meaning either,
אָמַר לֵיהּ הַאי בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה כְּתִיב
"he said to him: This is written about words of Torah!
A verse does not depart from its plain meaning."
And likewise here the intent is
at the second meal of Shabbos:
For bread is the sustenance of life,
And the essence of life is the Torah,
"See, I have set before you life,"
And regarding wine we find explicitly (Sanhedrin 38a):
so that they will say something," etc.;
וְסוֹד הַכַּוָּונָה עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And "secret" refers to the Oral Torah,
along the lines of what they said (Pesachim 111b):
is like that of a Torah scholar,"
for it is the way of the Torah scholar
to wrap himself in a scarf;
'the secret of Hashem is for those who fear Him'" (Tehillim 25:14);
is revealed only to those who fear Him,
that You have hidden away for those who fear You."
And so it is stated (Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 34):
"You say that you are My children," etc.;
"And for princes, where is strong drink?":
מִי שֶׁכׇּל רָזֵי עוֹלָם גְּלוּיִם לוֹ
"One to whom all the secrets of the world are revealed
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּכַמָּה דּוּכְתֵּי
as is written in the holy Zohar in several places.
the secret of the Oral Torah is revealed.
And this is "Hashem has sworn by His right hand":
"and by the arm of His might,"
שֶׁנִּדְרָשׁ גַּם כֵּן עַל תּוֹרָה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
which is also expounded as Torah, as mentioned above;
and this is the Oral Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קסז, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 167a)
and from the left was given
"I will no longer give your grain
יוּכַל לִהְיוֹת מִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ (תְּהִלִּים נ, טז)
there may be one of whom it is said (Tehillim 50:16):
What have you to do with recounting My statutes?",
and it is written in the holy books
that the evil inclination and the kelipos
and receive more vitality from it;
that is, from the bread of Torah,
"and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink"
is hungry and thirsty for words of Torah
is only to insert into his heart
to grow haughty or to provoke,
he will benefit from these words of Torah.
כִּי גֶחָלִים אַתָּה חוֹתֶה עַל רֹאשׁוֹ
"For you heap coals on his head";
for in the end his plan will not stand,
for in truth the words of Torah
for "the light within it will bring him back to the good,"
"Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water,"
as referring to an unworthy student;
although there is punishment for teaching him,
nevertheless to the student we say,
that he should strive to learn,
for the light within it will bring him back to the good.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב רַבֵּינוּ חַיִּים אוֹר זָרוּעַ
And as Rabbeinu Chaim Or Zarua wrote,
that although he will be punished
עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁכָּתְבוּ הַתּוֹסָפוֹת (תַּעֲנִית יא, א)
along the lines of what Tosafos wrote (Taanis 11a)
that he is punished and receives reward,
just as with one who fasts on Shabbos
אִם אֶתֵּן אֶת דְּגָנֵךְ עוֹד מַאֲכָל לְאוֹיְבַיִךְ
"I will no longer give your grain as food for your enemies";
that the evil inclination will not be able to rule
over the words of Torah that he learns.
And "your grain" alludes to the Written Torah,
which is the aspect of bread,
as it says, "Come, eat of my bread."
"And foreigners shall not drink your wine
that whenever there is revealed in the world
a new path in the Oral Torah,
novelties in external wisdoms among the nations.
in the time of Shimon HaTzaddik,
who was of the remnant of the Men of the Great Assembly,
Alexander of Macedon and his teacher,
that at the time when there was to be
the revelation of the Written Torah,
there was then the wisdom of Egypt;
there were still sorcerers and magicians,
opposite the prophets who were then in Yisrael.
And at the time that there began to spread
the wisdom of the Oral Torah,
which is in the manner of the Sages' own intellect,
what Hashem Yisbarach shines into them,
there began among them, opposite it,
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן מַה שֶּׁמְּחַדְּשִׁים מִשִּׂכְלָם
which is also what they innovate from their own intellect.
And of this it is said:
who are the nations of the world,
which alludes to the Oral Torah.
And so it is stated in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 8):
which is likened to the sun;
וּכְעֵין שֶׁאָמַר בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפח, א)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 188a)
הַשְּׂפַת אֱמֶת שֶׁתִּכּוֹן לָעַד (מִשְׁלֵי יב, יט)
"the lip of truth that will be established forever" (Mishlei 12:19);
and this is against the aspect of the Written Torah;
and of this it says, "And the sun will be ashamed."
is what they innovate with their intellect;
the moon that receives from the sun.
"And foreigners shall not drink your wine."
"For those who harvest it will eat it" (Yeshayahu 62:9)
הוּא נֶגֶד אִם אֶתֵּן דְּגָנֵךְ וְגוֹמֵר
corresponds to "I will no longer give your grain," etc.,
for in truth through the eating
they will come to words of Torah,
"and those who gather it will drink it"
and this is "they will drink it in the courtyards of My holiness,"
that it will be in the aspect of the wine
that "if he is worthy, it gladdens him,"
which is the secret of the Oral Torah,
